Comment: Fluxer music bot configuration. Requires Node.js >= 22.13.0. Run 'node --version' to verify.

rest.Comment: REST client options. 'timeout' is ms before a request to api.fluxer.app is aborted (default: 15000). Raise if you see DOMException AbortError in logs.

fluxer.js.Comment: Client options passed to @fluxerjs/core 3.0. NOTE: cache limits live here. The built-in defaults are bounded (guilds 2000, channels 5000, users 10000, members 5000, messages 20). Do NOT set cache values to false — in 3.0 `false` means UNBOUNDED, not disabled, and will OOM the bot on large guild counts. To override, e.g. "cache": { "users": 20000 }.

presenceContents-Comment: Each entry can be a plain string (e.g. 'Ping for Prefix') or an object. Objects support: text (required), emoji_name (unicode emoji or custom emoji name), emoji_id (snowflake ID for custom guild emojis only), activity ({ name, type, url? }). Activity types: 0=Playing, 1=Streaming, 2=Listening, 3=Watching, 5=Competing. For custom guild emojis, provide both emoji_name AND emoji_id. For unicode emojis, only emoji_name is needed.

nodelink.Comment: requestTimeout: ms before a NodeLink HTTP request is aborted. Default: 60000 (60s). Raise if you see 'NodeLink request timeout' errors. All audio sources (Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, etc.) are resolved by NodeLink, so configure source credentials in nodelink.config.json, not here.

bilibili.Comment: Bilibili video playback (%play https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV... , b23.tv short links and ?p= parts included). Bilibili's CDN only serves audio to requests with a bilibili Referer, so the bot runs a tiny local HTTP proxy that adds those headers and hands a signed URL to your NodeLink/Lavalink node. Defaults work when the node runs on the same host as the bot (nodelink.host = localhost). bind/port: what the proxy listens on (port 0 = pick a free port). advertiseHost: the host your audio node should use to reach the proxy — set it (e.g. your bot's LAN IP or Docker service name, and bind 0.0.0.0) only when the node runs on a different machine. cookie: optional browser cookie string from a logged-in browser — SESSDATA is the only part that matters (it unlocks higher audio quality and fixes 'Bilibili blocked this server's requests (HTTP 412)' on flagged hosting IPs). buvid3/buvid4/b_nut device cookies are generated and managed automatically; if you paste them anyway, placeholder-looking or malformed values are ignored. Copy the whole cookie header from your browser's devtools.

comment-radio.message: If you have radio stations you'd like to connect, add them to the array below. Radio stations must be rendered like following:

station.name: zamrock
station.url: url to stream from; this will be kept private

dashboard.Comment: Optional dashboard backend. When enabled, the bot speaks Redis RPC (request/response/info channels) with an external web frontend. Login codes are verified (bcrypt) from the MySQL login_codes table. Keep Redis network-isolated — the RPC channel has no shared secret.

lastfm.Comment: Last.fm integration: auto-scrobble songs, play loved/top/recent tracks. Register at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create

fluxerlist.Comment: FluxerList integration: check voters for your server/bot. API keys are allocated by site admins, prefixed with fl_, and visible in your Dashboard. To request access, open a ticket in the Fluxer server.

customStatsFooter: Text shown in the footer of the $prefixstats embed; optional.

logging.Comment: Control which log categories appear in the console. Set 'enabled' to false to silence everything except errors. Set any category to false to silence just that group.

timers.Comment: All timing values in milliseconds (ms). 1000ms = 1 second, 60000ms = 1 minute.

sharding-Comment: Optional process-level sharding (@fluxerjs/sharding 3.0, beta). Only read by 'node shard.mjs' / 'npm run shard' — plain 'npm start' ignores this block entirely. totalShards: total gateway shards (use an explicit number, never 'auto'); shardsPerProcess: how many shards each child process runs; respawn: restart dead children; spawnTimeout: ms to wait for a child's ready IPC; spawnDelay: ms between successive spawns. The FLUXER_TOTAL_SHARDS / FLUXER_SHARDS_PER_PROCESS env vars override the first two (handy for Docker). Sharding only matters at ~2500+ guilds; leave at defaults otherwise. Caveats: DMs only reach shard 0, and the dashboard is single-process-first.
